response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong D language, Node.js/TypeScript, and distributed-systems background, but his C++ experience is minimal (a single short stint over a decade ago) and there is no evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, MQTT, industrial protocols, or embedded/industrial automation domain expertise required for this role.
strengths: 10+ years of senior software engineering experience across web, backend, and distributed systems
Solid experience with networking, async I/O, fibers, and high-performance low-latency systems (in D, not C++)
Strong communication, mentoring, and open-source/workshop leadership track record
concerns: C++ experience is extremely limited — only ~6 months in 2014-2015, over a decade ago
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No mention of MQTT, message brokers, UML, or industrial/IoT protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)

key_factors.factor: Strong general senior engineering and distributed systems skills
